data.why: The app generates its own 15-image synthetic weld X-ray demo project in-app via a sidebar button ('打开合成演示项目'); no files need to be uploaded or seeded.

goals: Load the built-in synthetic weld X-ray demo project to see a ready-made annotation workspace with train/val/test splits
Import a batch of radiography images, group them by weld/plate ID, and assign them to train/val/test splits
Draw, edit, and confirm bounding-box annotations for porosity, crack, and inclusion defects on an image
Run the demo heuristic candidate detector on an uploaded or synthetic X-ray image to screen for defect regions
Train a YOLO11 model (CPU, from-scratch, 1 epoch on the demo set) on confirmed annotations and watch validation curves
Run batch auto-labeling with a trained model over pending images and review/correct the flagged candidates before confirming

review.summary: The tree describes the tool's purpose well and is accurate as far as it goes: every screen sampled supports the claim made about it, and the labels are clean. It is missing the human review and correction of model suggestions, which the README puts at the centre of the tool, and it is also missing batch import. It should be filed only after those gaps are added or marked not done, and after the unconfirmed training and export nodes are replayed.
